Cows eat many things besides "grass". They have 4 chamber stomach with many bacteria to break it all down so that they can get nutrients and energy our simple bodies could not provide. Animals that are fed an incomplete diet, lacking in some essential nutrients will show reduced health and fitness issues will arise. Modern beef cattle/ dairy milk cows are fed a blend of "feeds" that provide complete nutrition and checked regularly in the same way your doctor gives you a check up, and writes a prescription or diet that will presumably balance you out if things are not right.

Cows are a type of https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ruminant , just like many other vegetarian animals. They get the lion share of their amino acids (which get turned into proteins) by feeding special bacteria in their stomach (like their own internal microbe ranch) that can produce the amino acids/proteins by breaking down cellulose (which humans can't do) from the plants.

Animals (and us) synthesize quite a few nutrients that they need, but if a certain required nutrient is common in their usual diet, mutations can eliminate the "expensive" cellular machinery to do so with no ill effects. Apparently animals that eat only one thing are simply more complicated than the rest.
